name: hana
description: Chittagong’s best food, straight from local kitchens. No middlemen.

paragraphs: Hana is the Chittagonian word for food. Hana is a free, open directory of restaurants and grocery stores in Chittagong, Bangladesh, and a tool for preparing orders. It lists businesses, shows which ones deliver to your area, and prepares an order message that you send yourself, by WhatsApp, text message, email or whichever app the business uses. You pay the business on delivery or at pickup, in cash, by Bangla QR, by card on a terminal or by mobile wallet transfer.
Created by Hamid Yasir & Co. for the people of Chittagong. Managed by the Hana Community. See AUTHORS.md.
Questions about why Hana exists, how delivery works and how it stays free are answered in the FAQ.
